chunks: As for whatever is in it from Al-ʿAys ibn Al-Qasim, I have narrated it from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, from Yaʿqub ibn Yazid, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Al-ʿAys ibn Al-Qasim.

key_terms.الصَّفَّارِ: A key transmitter in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.الْعَيْصِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ: A narrator from whom reports are transmitted in this chain
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; an explicit statement of narration by the compiler
key_terms.صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى: An important narrator appearing in the transmission chain

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Al-ʿAys ibn Al-Qasim in Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Al-ʿAys ibn Al-Qasim in Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih. Its significance lies in documenting the transmission pathway for hadith authentication and source tracing within Shia hadith literature.
